title: Dimensionality Reduction in Lingual Articulation of Vowels: Evidence From Lax Vowels in Northern Anglo-English
why_promising: Primary production with 1,927 recorded vowel tokens (1,857 retained); audio was force-aligned but vowel boundaries were subsequently checked and manually corrected; ultrasound tongue data provide articulatory production information.
open_question: Locate/enumerate the public data deposit and determine which token-level acoustic and ultrasound trajectory files are accessible; preserve full tongue trajectories and corrected interval provenance rather than summary dimensions only.

title: Production of intonational phrase boundaries in Dutch

open_question: Locate a public repository/supplement with token-level measurements, TextGrids, F0/duration/prosodic variables and speaker/task metadata before core admission.

title: Speech production under stress for machine learning: multimodal dataset of 79 cases and 8 signals
